import pytest

from your_module import is_balanced_parens  # Replace with the actual module name


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "s",
    [
        "()",
        "[]",
        "{}",
        "()[]{}",
        "{[()]}",
        "([{}])",
        "[{()}([])]",
        "a(b[c]{d}e)f",
        "function_call(arg[0], {'key': [1, 2]})",
    ],
)
def test_balanced_parens_happy_path(s):
    assert is_balanced_parens(s) is True


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "s",
    [
        "",
        "no brackets here",
        "   ",
        "abc123!@#",
    ],
)
def test_edge_cases_with_no_bracket_characters_are_balanced(s):
    assert is_balanced_parens(s) is True


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "s",
    [
        "(",
        "[",
        "{",
        ")",
        "]",
        "}",
        "(]",

        "{]",

        "())",
        "([{}])]",
        "}{",
        ")(",
        "a(b[c]{d}e",
        "a(b]c",
    ],
)
def test_unbalanced_parens_return_false(s):
    assert is_balanced_parens(s) is False
